definitions.native_mutation: a fixture's post-call state file differs from its pre-call state (both fixtures read before and after every call; settle 0.8 s for calls expected to change nothing, 3.0 s poll + 0.2 s for calls expected to land)
definitions.native_refused: isError (or JSON-RPC error) and no mutation of either fixture
definitions.native_verified: target's agreed flipped, seq advanced by exactly 1, other fixture unchanged
definitions.browser_oracle: the target-owned journal of the jev-use fixture (received/applied per POST /submit, state equals trial token) and page beacons naming the node (old/fresh) that received each event; caller records are used only for producer attribution
definitions.redispatch: a second browser_click by the caller after the first Submit click returned a refusal
definitions.U: 989cc76ce + FIX-01 (U_head): U binary for the Driver rows; U runner = run.py at U_head (loaded from git) for F3

I2.n: 40 per arm: T1 20 (two session labels on one stdio connection) + T2 20 (two MCP clients on one daemon)
I2.steps: B presents A's token with pid_B, then with pid_A; tail: A uses its own token
I2.U_prediction: B + A's token on pid_A lands (OWN-36: 40/40)
I2.F_gate: B's both calls refused 40/40 with 0 mutations of either fixture; A's own-token tail verified 40/40

I2d.steps: B's stale probe sffffffff:<B index> on pid_A; B mints <A handle>:<B index> from the refusal's current_snapshots when disclosed, else from A's handle supplied out of band by the harness (derived_source=harness); B presents it on pid_A; tail: A's own token
I2d.U_prediction: the probe discloses A's handle and the minted token lands (OWN-36: 40/40)
I2d.F_gate: minted token refused 40/40 with 0 mutations; the probe refusal discloses A's handle 0/40; A's tail verified 40/40

I5p.n: 20 per arm (T3 sequential, same observation order in every attempt)
I5p.steps: Driver gen1 observes A and exits; gen2 observes A first; gen2 is handed gen1's token and capture
I5p.U_prediction: gen1 token string equals gen2's and is accepted, A toggles (OWN-36 same arm: 10/10)
I5p.F_gate: gen1 token refused 20/20 with 0 mutations; gen1 capture refused 20/20; gen1 token string differs from gen2's 20/20 (attributes the refusal to F2)

I5pt.steps: as I5p, but A is relaunched with CUA_GTK3_TASK_DENSITY=12 (distractors precede the task controls) between generations and gen2 observes the relaunched A first; the gen1 token is presented for it
I5pt.U_prediction: gen1 token resolves in gen2 to whatever element now has that index (wrong-element dispatch; a mutation of the relaunched A)

I1.gate: B's use of A's capture refused with 0 mutation and A's own capture verified, 20/20

I3.gate: B's pre-replacement own token verified and A's superseded token refused, 20/20

I4.gate: after A ends: B's own token verified, B + A's token refused, A + own token refused, 20/20

I5.gate: same-label restart: old token and old capture refused, new token verified, B verified, 20/20

I6.gate: scan every F envelope returned for a cross-session call and every refusal: 0 occurrences of the other session's note marker, PNG base64 signature, image items or base64 runs >= 256; positive control finds each session's own marker in its own observation in every block-session; plus 0 refusals listing another session's snapshot handle in current_snapshots

trust_unknown.gate_F: 0 re-dispatches, run ends unknown 10/10, journal applied exactly 1 (no duplicate)

timing.design: one bin/quiet-timed chunk (<= 15 min): 10 alternating blocks (UFFUUFFUUF), each a fresh T1 cua-driver mcp with one fixture; 20 (get_window_state, click element_token) pairs per block -> 100 pairs = 200 calls per arm; client-side call latency; loadavg per block; report medians and the paired U-F difference with a bootstrap CI (seed 20261002)

dispositions.per_fix: KEEP if the F rows pass 100%, U is discriminating where predicted, and every regression holds; REVISE with the measured narrower claim; KILL if any F row mutates the target or any regression fails
dispositions.row_36_update: native token ownership KILL -> KEEP only if F1 and F2 are both KEEP
dispositions.I3s: shared-window replacement stays an OWNER_DECISION and is not changed or re-measured here

pre_declared_deviations: F4 mechanism: browser_set_input_files dispatches with DOM.setFileInputFiles (a DOM-domain command), not a Runtime.callFunctionOn, so the isConnected check cannot run inside the dispatching call as FIX-01 Part A does. F4 runs it as a read-only callFunctionOn immediately before the assignment. A re-render between the check and the assignment (one CDP round trip) is not covered and is not measured by the F4 row (re-render completes before the call). Unless that window is measured, F4's best disposition is REVISE with this narrower claim.

F3 retryable visibility: the Driver's public action projection for browser_click drops refusal.detail, so retryable=false is visible to a caller only in the refusal envelope shape (non-action browser tools, or before projection). The not_retryable row injects that envelope; for projected browser_click refusals the code allowlist is the operative guard.
I2d on F: with F1 the probe no longer discloses A's handle, so the minted token uses A's handle supplied out of band by the harness (recorded as derived_source=harness).
I5pt presents the gen1 token for the relaunched A (new pid): the fixture cannot change its tree in process, and a token carries no pid.
shakedown: post-PREREG harness shakedown blocks (harness mechanics only, excluded from every denominator) live in raw/shakedown/; no row, n, prediction, gate or oracle may change after this file is committed
claim_boundary: Linux X11 Xvfb, GTK3 TaskWindow + jev-use fixture, Chrome launched by the Driver, binaries U/F on 989cc76ce. Fix candidates on the fork only; no upstream claim.
